slice.candidate: retained Git commit SHA plus GitHub commit-signature verification metadata as a repository-native independent witness

sources.title: GitHub REST API endpoints for commits
sources.observed: Public commit reads can be performed without authentication for public resources; commit responses expose a verification object including verified, reason, signature, payload and verified_at.

sources.title: GitHub REST API endpoints for Git commits
sources.observed: A Git commit object is retrieved by commit_sha and exposes GitHub signature-verification metadata.

sources.title: Git git-prune documentation
sources.observed: Git pruning removes objects unreachable from refs; therefore a retained SHA does not itself guarantee indefinite object retention after all refs cease to reach the commit.

sources.title: Git git-gc documentation
sources.observed: Git garbage collection can expire unreachable objects, so deletion-surviving availability cannot be inferred from content addressing alone.

No O, downstream, other-worker state, legacy research, shared ledger, other-role receipts/configs, private repository, secret, POST, hosted runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package, external executor, manual witness, scheduler mutation, wait/poll/backoff, or second leaf was used.

comparison.expected_completion_time: low for reachable-object lookup; unbounded/failed for deletion-surviving witness because retention is not guaranteed
comparison.success_probability: high for exact provenance while the commit remains retrievable; low for the required deletion-surviving independent-witness property
comparison.conflict_duplication_risk: low for exact-object identity by full SHA; medium for semantic duplicate detection because distinct commits can encode equivalent payloads with different metadata/SHAs

falsification.overwrite_resistance: PASS_WITH_SCOPE: a retained full SHA addresses an exact Git object; ref rewrites do not mutate that already-identified object.
falsification.discoverability_after_ref_mutation: PASS_WITH_SCOPE_ONLY_IF_SHA_RETAINED_AND_OBJECT_REMAINS_AVAILABLE: direct SHA lookup is addressable while the object is retained, but the repository graph no longer provides discovery once all refs lose reachability unless another durable identifier/witness exists.
falsification.exact_provenance: PASS_WITH_SCOPE: GitHub exposes commit and signature-verification metadata for a retrievable commit.
falsification.deletion_resistance: FAIL_CLOSED: upstream Git explicitly permits pruning unreachable objects; no GitHub guarantee was found that a commit remains indefinitely retrievable after all repository refs are removed.
falsification.independent_witness: FAIL_CLOSED: GitHub verification metadata is returned with the same retrievable commit object and does not establish a separately retained deletion-surviving witness independent of repository object retention.
